activation_condition: Exact digest-bound approval of the G1 proposal, C1 proposal, and generated G1 inline output; then approval-bound implementation and Gate R1.

alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Would leave spelling authority ambiguous after a correct LinkedIn profile match.

alternatives_considered.alternative: Use URL slug as canonical spelling
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Slugs can be abbreviated, stale, surname-only, or otherwise non-display forms.

alternatives_considered.alternative: Use LinkedIn display name after identity resolution
alternatives_considered.reason: Deterministic spelling source while preserving separate evidence requirements for identity and organizational facts.

controls: Require a correctly resolved profile/person match first.
Preserve source variants as governed aliases/mentions when useful.
Keep Nick/Nicholas separate until direct identity evidence resolves each mention.
Require current authoritative evidence for role/currentness facts.
effective_package: NEE_v47.2 if later implemented and packaged
migration_impact: One policy-card change plus mirror synchronization; NEE_00/15/16 propagation; no automatic alias, rename, or merge migration.
problem_evidence: Nick / Nicholas Krivov unresolved roster collision
risks: Wrong profile match could normalize to the wrong person.
Users may overread spelling authority as identity or role authority.
rollback_or_forward_repair: Restore baseline NEE_99/NEE_00/NEE_15/NEE_16 bytes and policy mirror; retain source variants and unresolved identity validations; regenerate derivatives.
selected_decision: After a person/profile match is correctly resolved, use the LinkedIn profile display name as canonical personal-name spelling. Do not use URL slugs, snippets, or name similarity to prove spelling or identity. The rule establishes no role, affiliation, reporting line, ownership, decision right, or currentness fact.
tests: Correct profile display name wins over source typo after identity match.
URL slug alone cannot rename a person.
Nick/Nicholas stays separate without identity evidence.
Role/currentness answers do not cite spelling authority.
NEE_99 and root mirror are body-identical after implementation.
title: LinkedIn display-name authority for personal-name spelling
